description: Phase 8 cross-backend validation on ibm_kingston for the two n=3 Grover-Rudolph raw direct-distribution circuits. This campaign compares backend dependence against the Phase 7 ibm_fez results and does not run Grover amplification or QAE.
rationale: Phase 7 on ibm_fez showed that n=3 global distributions were not uniformly stable under higher-shot repetition.
ibm_kingston has the same cz-based basis family and currently has a short queue, making it a suitable cross-backend control.
The campaign tests whether n=3 drift is backend-specific or circuit-family-specific.
Only direct distribution loading is measured.

selected_cases.label: sin2(pi x / 2), 8 midpoint cells
selected_cases.purpose: Cross-backend raw validation of the monotone n=3 profile.

selected_cases.label: sin2(pi x), 8 midpoint cells
selected_cases.purpose: Cross-backend raw validation of the symmetric n=3 profile.

stopping_rules: Do not infer amplified-QAE viability from this campaign.
If Kingston improves TVD and functional stability relative to Fez, prepare a focused cross-backend paper-quality comparison.
If Kingston reproduces the Phase 7 drift, classify the effect as circuit-family or mitigation-independent sensitivity rather than a Fez-only issue.
